titleNative: 本好きの下剋上~司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません~ 第三部 「領地に本を広げよう!」
synonyms: Honzuki no Gekokujou ~Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen~ Dai 3-bu 「Ryouchi ni Hon o Hirogeyou!」
synopsis: Manga adaptation of Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou . To protect those she cares about from danger, Myne abandons the life she knows to become Rozemyne, the archduke’s mana-rich adopted daughter. But her passion for books hasn’t changed, nor does she hesitate to charge into another strange new world. In this biblio-fantasy by bookworms, for bookworms, the detailed setting continues to expand—and so too does the book-making industry! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Please Bully Me, Miss Villainess!
titleRomaji: Qing Qifu Wo Ba, Eyi Xiaojie!
synopsis: Yifang found herself transported into the body of a villainess in an otome game. As the villainess Yvonne, she was supposed to be hated by the readers, as she bullies the FMC and helps the main characters come together. But there seems to be something wrong with this game's main character Elsa! "Hey, I told you not to come so close!" "Oh Yvonne… so how would you like to bully me today..." (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Inochi no Tabekata
synopsis: Otogiri Tobi, a 2nd grade middle school student, spends his depressing days searching for his missing older brother alongside his inhuman companion, Baku. Tobi used to rarely speak to anyone besides Baku, however one day after his classmate Shiratama Ryuuko suddenly approaches him, his life begins to change...? This is an adventure surrounding the "human" and the "inhuman" that a lone boy faces. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
